selection: max validation balanced accuracy, then min validation RMSE, then min hidden neurons
test_usage: T held out from current model selection; T was inspected in prior coursework, so it is not a new blind external test
grouping: All identical textual person labels kept in one partition; identical strings are dataset groups, identity not externally verified
balancing_policy: Class ratios are close to balanced; no oversampling on a tiny grouped dataset
outlier_policy: IQR flags reviewed descriptively; unusual valid coded values retained, no residual-based deletion
training_execution: Native Nsim5 UI only; this script prepares inputs and analysis, does not train a network
